calculation_handling.description: The minimum lot frontage equals the lot frontage that existed on the day of the enactment of By-law 569-2013; it needs the as-built history of the lot.
calculation_handling.gaps: The lot frontage as it existed on the day of the enactment is not held.

units.disclosure: If the lot frontage existed on the day of the enactment of By-law 569-2013 (May 9, 2013), you may use that existing frontage as the minimum lot frontage, provided the other provisions of this exception are met. A new lot is answered as if this does not apply.

calculation_handling.description: The minimum lot area equals the lot area that existed on the day of the enactment of By-law 569-2013; it needs the as-built history of the lot.
calculation_handling.gaps: The lot area as it existed on the day of the enactment is not held.

units.disclosure: If the lot area existed on the day of the enactment of By-law 569-2013 (May 9, 2013), you may use that existing lot area as the minimum lot area, provided the other provisions of this exception are met. A new lot is answered as if this does not apply.

calculation_handling.description: Maximum lot coverage is 50 percent of the lot area.
A detached house must have at least 2 storeys.
The second storey gross floor area must be at least 70 percent of the first floor gross floor area; a ratio between two storeys has no modelled target.
calculation_handling.gaps: No target for the gross floor area of an individual storey.

units.disclosure: The second storey must have a gross floor area of at least 70 percent of the gross floor area of the first floor. This is not evaluated automatically; check it against your plans.

calculation_handling.description: The minimum gross floor area of a detached house is the gross floor area that existed on the day of the enactment of By-law 569-2013; it needs the as-built history of the building.
calculation_handling.gaps: The gross floor area as it existed on the day of the enactment is not held.

units.disclosure: If the detached house existed on the day of the enactment of By-law 569-2013 (May 9, 2013), you may keep the gross floor area it had on that day as the minimum gross floor area, provided the other provisions of this exception are met. A new build is answered as if this does not apply.

calculation_handling.description: Minimum side yard setback is 0.45 m where the lot frontage is less than 12.0 m.
Minimum side yard setback is 0.75 m where the lot frontage is 12.0 m or more.
In a front yard or rear yard, a platform with a floor higher than the first floor above established grade may not encroach into the required yard setback.
calculation_handling.gaps: Platform floor height relative to the first floor is not held.

calculation_handling.description: No prevailing by-laws or sections apply.
The minimum lot frontage equals the lot frontage that existed on the day of the enactment of By-law 569-2013; it needs the as-built history of the lot.
calculation_handling.gaps: The lot frontage as it existed on the day of the enactment is not held.

units.disclosure: If the lot frontage existed on the day of the enactment of By-law 569-2013 (May 9, 2013), you may use that existing frontage as the minimum lot frontage, provided the other provisions of this exception are met. A new lot is answered as if this does not apply.

calculation_handling.description: The minimum lot area equals the lot area that existed on the day of the enactment of By-law 569-2013; it needs the as-built history of the lot.
calculation_handling.gaps: The lot area as it existed on the day of the enactment is not held.

units.disclosure: If the lot area existed on the day of the enactment of By-law 569-2013 (May 9, 2013), you may use that existing lot area as the minimum lot area, provided the other provisions of this exception are met. A new lot is answered as if this does not apply.

calculation_handling.description: A 7.5 m minimum building setback applies where the front lot line abuts Braymore Blvd. or Dean Rd.; a setback tied to a named street has no modelled form.
calculation_handling.gaps: Named-street frontage (Braymore Blvd. or Dean Rd.) is not held.

units.disclosure: Where the front lot line abuts Braymore Blvd. or Dean Rd., the minimum building setback from the front lot line is 7.5 metres. This is not evaluated automatically; check your street frontage.

calculation_handling.description: Minimum building setback from a front lot line that abuts a street is 6.0 m in all cases other than the Braymore Blvd. or Dean Rd. frontages.
calculation_handling.gaps: The other-than-named-street scope (the 7.5 m arm on Braymore Blvd. or Dean Rd.) is not held.

calculation_handling.description: Minimum building setback from a side lot line that abuts a street is 4.5 m.
Minimum building setback from a side lot line is 1.2 m.
Minimum building setback from a rear lot line is 1.2 m.
Maximum lot coverage is 40 percent of the lot area.
An attached or detached garage must be set back at least 0.3 m from a side lot line that does not abut a street.
The required parking space must be located in the residential building.
No prevailing by-laws or sections apply.

900.3.10(1209).explanation: Exception RD 1209 keeps the lot frontage and lot area that existed when By-law 569-2013 was enacted, caps lot coverage at 50 percent, requires a detached house to have at least 2 storeys with a second storey of at least 70 percent of the first floor area, keeps the existing minimum gross floor area, sets the side yard setback at 0.45 m (frontage under 12.0 m) or 0.75 m (frontage 12.0 m or more), and bars higher platforms from encroaching into front or rear yard setbacks.

900.3.10(599).explanation: Exception RD 599 keeps the lot frontage and lot area that existed when By-law 569-2013 was enacted, sets front setbacks (7.5 m on Braymore Blvd. or Dean Rd., otherwise 6.0 m), 4.5 m on a street side, 1.2 m on side and rear lot lines, caps lot coverage at 40 percent, requires garages to be 0.3 m from a non-street side lot line, and requires the parking space to be inside the residential building.
